versos.hebraico: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ לְדָוִ֗ד מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃
יָק֣וּם אֱ֭לֹהִים יָפ֣וּצוּ אוֹיְבָ֑יו וְיָנ֥וּסוּ מְ֝שַׂנְאָ֗יו מִפָּנָֽיו׃

controles.web: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.
controles.kjv: Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
controles.livre: Deus se levantará, e seus inimigos serão dispersos, e os que o odeiam fugirão de sua presença.

versos.hebraico: כְּהִנְדֹּ֥ף עָשָׁ֗ן תִּ֫נְדֹּ֥ף כְּהִמֵּ֣ס דּ֭וֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵ֑שׁ יֹאבְד֥וּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
controles.kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
controles.livre: Assim como a fumaça se espalha, tu os espalharás; assim como a cera que se derrete diante do fogo, assim também os perversos perecerão diante de Deus.

versos.hebraico: וְֽצַדִּיקִ֗ים יִשְׂמְח֣וּ יַֽ֭עַלְצוּ לִפְנֵ֥י אֱלֹהִ֗ים וְיָשִׂ֥ישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָֽה׃

controles.web: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.
controles.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
controles.livre: Mas os justos se alegrarão, e saltarão de prazer perante Deus, e se encherão de alegria.

versos.hebraico: שִׁ֤ירוּ׀ לֵֽאלֹהִים֮ זַמְּר֪וּ שְׁ֫מ֥וֹ סֹ֡לּוּ לָרֹכֵ֣ב בָּ֭עֲרָבוֹת בְּיָ֥הּ שְׁמ֗וֹ וְעִלְז֥וּ לְפָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!
controles.kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.
controles.livre: Cantai a Deus, cantai louvores ao seu nome; exaltai aquele que anda montado sobre as nuvens, pois EU-SOU é o seu nome; e alegrai -vos diante dele.

versos.hebraico: אֲבִ֣י יְ֭תוֹמִים וְדַיַּ֣ן אַלְמָנ֑וֹת אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בִּמְע֥וֹן קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
controles.kjv: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
controles.livre: Ele é o pai dos órfãos, e juiz que defende as viúvas; Deus na habitação de sua santidade.

versos.hebraico: אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ מ֘וֹשִׁ֤יב יְחִידִ֨ים׀ בַּ֗יְתָה מוֹצִ֣יא אֲ֭סִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁר֑וֹת אַ֥ךְ ס֝וֹרֲרִ֗ים שָׁכְנ֥וּ צְחִיחָֽה׃

controles.web: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
controles.kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.
controles.livre: Deus que faz os solitários viverem em uma família, e liberta os prisioneiros; mas os rebeldes habitam em terra seca.

versos.hebraico: אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים בְּ֭צֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ֖ בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.
controles.kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
controles.livre: Deus, quando tu saías perante teu povo, enquanto caminhavas pelo deserto (Selá),

versos.hebraico: אֶ֤רֶץ רָעָ֨שָׁה׀ אַף־שָׁמַ֣יִם נָטְפוּ֮ מִפְּנֵ֪י אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים זֶ֥ה סִינַ֑י מִפְּנֵ֥י אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
controles.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
controles.livre: A terra se abalava, e os céus se derramavam perante a presença de Deus; neste Sinai, diante da presença de Deus, o Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: גֶּ֣שֶׁם נְ֭דָבוֹת תָּנִ֣יף אֱלֹהִ֑ים נַחֲלָתְךָ֥ וְ֝נִלְאָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה כֽוֹנַנְתָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.
controles.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
controles.livre: Tu fizeste a chuva cair abundantemente, e firmaste tu herança, que estava cansada.

versos.hebraico: חַיָּתְךָ֥ יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָ֑הּ תָּ֤כִ֥ין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ֖ לֶעָנִ֣י אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
controles.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
controles.livre: Nela o teu rebanho habitou; por tua bondade, Deus, sustentaste ao miserável.

versos.hebraico: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִתֶּן־אֹ֑מֶר הַֽ֝מְבַשְּׂר֗וֹת צָבָ֥א רָֽב׃

controles.web: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.
controles.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.
controles.livre: O Senhor falou; grande é o exército das que anunciam as boas novas.

versos.hebraico: מַלְכֵ֣י צְ֭בָאוֹת יִדֹּד֣וּן יִדֹּד֑וּן וּנְוַת בַּ֝֗יִת תְּחַלֵּ֥ק שָׁלָֽל׃

controles.web: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,
controles.kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
controles.livre: Reis de exércitos fugiam apressadamente;  e aquela que ficava em casa repartia os despojos.

versos.hebraico: אִֽם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן֮ בֵּ֪ין שְׁפַ֫תָּ֥יִם כַּנְפֵ֣י י֭וֹנָה נֶחְפָּ֣ה בַכֶּ֑סֶף וְ֝אֶבְרוֹתֶ֗יהָ בִּֽירַקְרַ֥ק חָרֽוּץ׃

controles.web: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.
controles.kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
controles.livre: Ainda que estivésseis cercados por ambos os lados, estais protegidos como que por asas de pomba, cobertas de prata, e suas penas revestidas de ouro.

versos.hebraico: בְּפָ֘רֵ֤שׂ שַׁדַּ֓י מְלָ֘כִ֤ים בָּ֗הּ תַּשְׁלֵ֥ג בְּצַלְמֽוֹן׃

controles.web: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.
controles.kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.
controles.livre: Quando o Todo-Poderoso espalhou os reis, houve neve em Salmom.

versos.hebraico: הַר־אֱ֭לֹהִים הַר־בָּשָׁ֑ן הַ֥ר גַּ֝בְנֻנִּ֗ים הַר־בָּשָֽׁן׃

controles.web: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.
controles.kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.
controles.livre: O monte de Deus é como o monte de Basã; é um monte bem alto, como o monte de Basã.

versos.hebraico: לָ֤מָּה׀ תְּֽרַצְּדוּן֮ הָרִ֪ים גַּבְנֻ֫נִּ֥ים הָהָ֗ר חָמַ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְשִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אַף־יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָנֶֽצַח׃

controles.web: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there forever.
controles.kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.
controles.livre: Por que olhais com inveja, ó montes altos? A este monte Deus desejou para ser sua habitação; e o SENHOR habitará nele para sempre.

versos.hebraico: רֶ֤כֶב אֱלֹהִ֗ים רִבֹּתַ֣יִם אַלְפֵ֣י שִׁנְאָ֑ן אֲדֹנָ֥י בָ֝֗ם סִינַ֥י בַּקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: The chariots of God are twenty thousand, even thousands of angels: the Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in the holy place.
controles.livre: As carruagens de Deus são várias dezenas de milhares; o Senhor está entre elas, como em Sinai, em seu santuário.

versos.hebraico: עָ֘לִ֤יתָ לַמָּר֨וֹם׀ שָׁ֘בִ֤יתָ שֶּׁ֗בִי לָקַ֣חְתָּ מַ֭תָּנוֹת בָּאָדָ֑ם וְאַ֥ף ס֝וֹרְרִ֗ים לִשְׁכֹּ֤ן׀ יָ֬הּ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah God might dwell there.
controles.kjv: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, for the rebellious also, that the Lord God might dwell among them.
controles.livre: Tu subiste ao alto, levaste cativos, recebeste bens dos homens, até dos rebeldes, para que ali o SENHOR Deus habitasse.

versos.hebraico: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם׀ י֥וֹם יַֽעֲמָס־לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.
controles.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.
controles.livre: Bendito seja o Senhor; dia após dia ele nos carrega; Deus é nossa salvação. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: הָ֤אֵ֣ל׀ לָנוּ֮ אֵ֤ל לְֽמוֹשָׁ֫ע֥וֹת וְלֵיהוִ֥ה אֲדֹנָ֑י לַ֝מָּ֗וֶת תּוֹצָאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: God is to us a God of deliverance. To Yahweh, the Lord, belongs escape from death.
controles.kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.
controles.livre: Nosso Deus é um Deus de salvação; e com o Senhor DEUS há livramento para a morte;

versos.hebraico: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִמְחַץ֮ רֹ֤אשׁ אֹ֫יְבָ֥יו קָדְקֹ֥ד שֵׂעָ֑ר מִ֝תְהַלֵּ֗ךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָֽיו׃

controles.web: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.
controles.kjv: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, and the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
controles.livre: Pois Deus ferirá a cabeça de seus inimigos, o topo da cabeça, onde ficam os cabelos, daquele que anda na prática de suas transgressões.

versos.hebraico: אָמַ֣ר אֲ֭דֹנָי מִבָּשָׁ֣ן אָשִׁ֑יב אָ֝שִׁ֗יב מִֽמְּצֻל֥וֹת יָֽם׃

controles.web: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;
controles.kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:
controles.livre: O Senhor disse: Eu os farei voltar de Basã; eu os farei voltar das profundezas do mar.

versos.hebraico: לְמַ֤עַן׀ תִּֽמְחַ֥ץ רַגְלְךָ֗ בְּ֫דָ֥ם לְשׁ֥וֹן כְּלָבֶ֑יךָ מֵאֹיְבִ֥ים מִנֵּֽהוּ׃

controles.web: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”
controles.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
controles.livre: Para que metas teu pé no sangue dos teus inimigos; e nele também terá uma parte a língua de cada um de teus cães.

versos.hebraico: רָא֣וּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶ֣יךָ אֱלֹהִ֑ים הֲלִ֘יכ֤וֹת אֵלִ֖י מַלְכִּ֣י בַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
controles.livre: Viram teus caminhos, ó Deus; os caminhos de meu Deus, meu Rei, no santuário.

versos.hebraico: קִדְּמ֣וּ שָׁ֭רִים אַחַ֣ר נֹגְנִ֑ים בְּת֥וֹךְ עֲ֝לָמ֗וֹת תּוֹפֵפֽוֹת׃

controles.web: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, in the midst of the ladies playing with tambourines,
controles.kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.
controles.livre: Os cantores vieram adiante, depois os instrumentistas; entre eles as virgens tocadoras de tamborins.

versos.hebraico: בְּֽ֭מַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכ֣וּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִמְּק֥וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”
controles.kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
controles.livre: Bendizei a Deus nas congregações; bendizei ao SENHOR, desde a fonte de Israel.

versos.hebraico: שָׁ֤ם בִּנְיָמִ֨ן׀ צָעִ֡יר רֹדֵ֗ם שָׂרֵ֣י יְ֭הוּדָה רִגְמָתָ֑ם שָׂרֵ֥י זְ֝בֻל֗וּן שָׂרֵ֥י נַפְתָּלִֽי׃

controles.web: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
controles.kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.
controles.livre: Ali está o pequeno Benjamim, que domina sobre eles; os chefes de Judá e a congregação deles; os chefes de Zebulom, e os chefes de Nafitali.

versos.hebraico: צִוָּ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ עֻ֫זֶּ֥ךָ עוּזָּ֥ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים ז֝֗וּ פָּעַ֥לְתָּ לָּֽנוּ׃

controles.web: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.
controles.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
controles.livre: Teu Deus ordenou tua força; fortalece, ó Deus, o que já operaste por nós.

versos.hebraico: מֵֽ֭הֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְךָ֤ יוֹבִ֖ילוּ מְלָכִ֣ים שָֽׁי׃

controles.web: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.
controles.kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
controles.livre: Ao teu templo, em Jerusalém, os Reis te trarão presentes.

versos.hebraico: גְּעַ֨ר חַיַּ֪ת קָנֶ֡ה עֲדַ֤ת אַבִּירִ֨ים׀ בְּעֶגְלֵ֬י עַמִּ֗ים מִתְרַפֵּ֥ס בְּרַצֵּי־כָ֑סֶף בִּזַּ֥ר עַ֝מִּ֗ים קְרָב֥וֹת יֶחְפָּֽצוּ׃

controles.web: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.
controles.kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.
controles.livre: Repreende a fera das canas, a multidão de touros, juntamente com as bezerras dos povos; aos que humilham a si mesmos em troca de peças e prata; dissipa aos povos que gostam da guerra.

versos.hebraico: יֶאֱתָ֣יוּ חַ֭שְׁמַנִּים מִנִּ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם כּ֥וּשׁ תָּרִ֥יץ יָ֝דָ֗יו לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
controles.kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
controles.livre: Embaixadores virão do Egito; Cuxe correrá para estender suas mãos a Deus.

versos.hebraico: מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָ֭אָרֶץ שִׁ֣ירוּ לֵאלֹהִ֑ים זַמְּר֖וּ אֲדֹנָ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

controles.web: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.
controles.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
controles.livre: Reinos da terra, cantai a Deus; cantai louvores ao Senhor. (Selá)

versos.hebraico: לָ֭רֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵ֣י שְׁמֵי־קֶ֑דֶם הֵ֥ן יִתֵּ֥ן בְּ֝קוֹלוֹ ק֣וֹל עֹֽז׃

controles.web: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.
controles.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.
controles.livre: Ele anda montado por entre os céus desde os tempos antigos; eis que sua voz fala poderosamente.

versos.hebraico: תְּנ֥וּ עֹ֗ז לֵֽאלֹ֫הִ֥ים עַֽל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל גַּאֲוָת֑וֹ וְ֝עֻזּ֗וֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִֽים׃

controles.web: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.
controles.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.
controles.livre: Reconhecei o poder de Deus; sobre Israel está sua exaltação, e sua força está nas altas nuvens.

versos.hebraico: נ֤וֹרָ֥א אֱלֹהִ֗ים מִֽמִּקְדָּ֫שֶׁ֥יךָ אֵ֤ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל ה֤וּא נֹתֵ֨ן׀ עֹ֖ז וְתַעֲצֻמ֥וֹת לָעָ֗ם בָּר֥וּךְ אֱלֹהִֽים׃

controles.web: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!
controles.kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.
controles.livre: Deus, tu és temível desde teus santuários; o Deus de Israel é o que dá força e poder ao povo. Bendito seja Deus!
